latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Refund & Return Strategist.

- Helps users choose the best approach for refund, return, or exchange issues based on order and platform details.
- Recommends one of four strategies: firm claim, friendly negotiation, evidence supplement, or escalation.
- Drafts tailored communication for users to send to customer service.
- Outlines safety boundaries, including no legal advice or direct platform contact.
